item.title: rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner: Turn off ads, trending searches, news recommendations, and marketing push notifications in domestic Android phone systems. No root required, reversible, supports one-click execution by AI agents.

item.title: Apple Reportedly Announcing New MacBook Pro With OLED Touchscreen on Wednesday
item.description: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple plans to unveil 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays on October 28. The new models could cost up to $500 more than current mini-LED versions. Why it matters: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro would mark a major shift in its product strategy.

item.title: Workers' Party positions 'not always consistent or coherent', S'pore 'must guard against populism': PM Wong

item.title: YesWiki 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 and 5.0.0-alpha1 before 5.0.0-alpha4 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection…
item.description: CVE-2026-116207 (CVSS 8.8) is an unauthenticated SQL injection in YesWiki's public Bazar search API, in versions 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 and 5.0.0-alpha1 before 5.0.0-alpha4. Attackers could read data such as user password hashes or exhaust database threads. Why it matters: An unauthenticated SQL injection in a web app that can expose password hashes is a serious cybersecurity risk.
